name: Thandiwe Nkosi
bio:
Thandiwe Nkosi's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly, not on the track, but in the data analysis rooms. After completing her engineering degree at the University of Cape Town, she initially worked with a Formula Student team, honing her skills in vehicle dynamics and simulations. It was here she discovered her true passion lay in the strategic application of technical knowledge to optimize performance.

Transitioning to professional racing, Thandiwe quickly ascended the ranks, demonstrating an exceptional ability to identify and resolve technical bottlenecks. Her sharp eye for detail and meticulous approach to race preparation have earned her a reputation as a demanding but highly effective sporting director. At Hitech GP, she focuses on fostering a culture of continuous improvement, pushing her team to extract every last tenth of a second from their cars and drivers. She is known for her innovative strategies in pit stop optimization and race-day decision-making.

Thandiwe's distinctive approach combines a data-driven methodology with an intuitive understanding of driver psychology. She believes in empowering her team members, encouraging them to take ownership of their respective areas of expertise, while maintaining rigorous standards of accountability.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped natural hair with subtle graying at the temples.
physical.description: Thandiwe is a woman of medium height with a strong, focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in casual settings.
Insists on reviewing all telemetry data personally before each race.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on her desk, each representing a significant victory.
